children: Michael Burry (Trades, Portfolio) has expanded his wagers against several technology-related assets, adding to short positions in Micron Technology (MU), Nebius Group (NBIS), and Palantir Technologies (PLTR), according to a Sept. 22 post on his Substack.

The investor linked his latest moves to concerns that increasing memory-chip production could ease supply constraints that have supported parts of the semiconductor market. He pointed to recent industry commentary suggesting shortages remain limited to certain products, while other memory categories are showing signs of excess inventory.

Burry cited observations from Acer management indicating demand remains firm for some advanced memory components, including LPDDR5 and DDR5 9600. However, he noted that older-generation DDR4 products appear to be facing a more balanced-to-oversupplied market, which could affect pricing trends.
He also warned that the Nasdaq 100 Index (NDX) remains heavily concentrated, adding that a broader increase in memory supply could create pressure across portions of the technology sector.

title: Michael Burry Sends Fresh Warnings on Micron, Palantir Stocks
